name: What happens if engineering coordination is overlooked in a renovation?

mainEntity.name: What happens if engineering coordination is overlooked in a renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Overlooking engineering coordination in a renovation can lead to significant problems, including structural instability, unsafe electrical or plumbing systems, and non-compliance with local building codes. These issues can result in costly rework, project delays, fines, and potentially voiding home insurance policies. More critically, an unengineered renovation can compromise the safety and long-term value of your home. AKN Design Group emphasizes comprehensive engineering coordination from the outset, believing that true value in home improvement comes from customized solutions that enhance functionality, beauty, and long-term value, rather than quick fixes. We ensure all technical aspects are rigorously vetted to prevent future complications.
acceptedAnswer.description: Overlooking engineering coordination can cause structural issues, safety hazards, code violations, costly rework, and project delays.
